title: Melt Wide to Long
seoDescription: Reshape a pandas DataFrame from wide to long format using selected identifier and value columns.
description:
Unpivot a DataFrame from wide format to long tidy format with identifier variables and variable-value columns.

Wide tables with measurements in multiple columns violate first normal form. Melting into long format aligns datasets with tidy data standards for regression modeling.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
\text{pd.melt}(\text{df}, \text{id\_vars}, \text{value\_vars})
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Preserve identifying columns listed in id_vars
2. Unpivot columns listed in value_vars into rows
3. Name melted columns var_name and value_name and return list of dictionaries

### Returns
List of unpivoted record dictionaries.

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
The implementation computes **Melt Wide to Long** by following direct mathematical principles, leveraging vectorized operations to ensure both correctness and optimal runtime efficiency.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import pandas as pd

def pandas_melt_wide_to_long(records: list, id_vars: list, value_vars: list, var_name: str = 'variable', value_name: str = 'value') -> list:
    return pd.melt(pd.DataFrame(records), id_vars=id_vars, value_vars=value_vars, var_name=var_name, value_name=value_name).to_dict(orient='records')
```
